description: Fig. 4 is a 15-panel composite (five rows x three columns) combining SEM micrographs with EDS spectra and composition tables for a high-Al, low-density medium-Mn steel intercritically annealed at 750 °C. Rows are labelled IA750_5 Min, IA750_30 Min, IA750_60 Min, IA750_120 Min and IA750_180 Min; orientation arrows at lower left mark ND (normal direction, vertical) and RD (rolling direction, horizontal). Column 1 gives low-magnification SEM (scale bars read as 10 µm in A1/B1/D1 and 20 µm in C1/E1) with phases labelled δ and α/γ; column 2 gives higher-magnification SEM (2 µm bars in A2/B2/C2, 5 µm in D2/E2) resolving needle-shaped reverted austenite (red arrow in A2) and globular reverted austenite (red outline in C2), plus yellow plus-sign, red-star and coloured-dot EDS spots. Column 3 (A3-E3) holds an EDS spectrum (x-axis 0.00-9.00 keV, y-axis counts, peaks labelled C, Al, Si, Mn, Fe) with an inset table giving Al and Mn in wt.% for δ-ferrite, intercritical ferrite, untransformed austenite and reverted austenite. The figure shows δ-ferrite composition is nearly constant across annealing times, while Mn in untransformed austenite rises (8.07 -> 9.42 wt.%) as reverted austenite stays Mn-leaner and progressively dissolves.

observations.observation: The figure is built from five rows, each carrying one low-magnification SEM, one high-magnification SEM and one EDS spectrum with an inset composition table (panels A1-A3 through E1-E3), i.e. 10 SEM micrographs and 5 EDS/table panels.

The inset EDS tables tabulate only Al and Mn, in wt.%, for δ-ferrite, intercritical ferrite, untransformed austenite and reverted austenite, although C, Al, Si, Mn and Fe peaks are all labelled on the spectra.

Table A3 gives δ-ferrite Al 5.37±0.05 wt.% and Mn 7.09±0.09 wt.%, untransformed austenite Al 4.50±0.14 wt.% and Mn 8.07±0.11 wt.%, and reverted austenite Al 4.43±0.05 wt.% and Mn 8.30±0.20 wt.% for IA750_5 Min.
Table C3 shows the largest separation within the series: untransformed austenite Mn 9.83±0.37 wt.% versus reverted austenite Mn 7.58±0.14 wt.% in IA750_60 Min.
Mn in untransformed austenite increases with annealing time across the tables: 8.07±0.11 (A3), 9.15±0.05 (D3) and 9.42±0.10 wt.% (E3).
Mn in δ-ferrite decreases slightly from 7.09±0.09 wt.% (A3) to 6.62±0.22 wt.% (E3), while δ-ferrite Al stays between about 5.2 and 5.9 wt.% in every table.
The EDS spectra span 0.00-9.00 keV on the x-axis with labelled C, Al, Si, Mn and Fe peaks; the Fe (~6.4 keV) and Mn (~5.9 keV) peaks are the tallest features in each spectrum.
Orientation arrows at the lower-left of the composite give ND vertically and RD horizontally, so all micrographs are viewed in the rolling/normal plane.

Needle-shaped reverted austenite is annotated with a red arrow in A2, and the region of interest analysed later by HRTEM/APT is outlined by a red circle in C2, where globular reverted austenite also appears.

The caption identifies the five rows as annealing at 750 °C for 5, 30, 60, 120 and 180 minutes and defines the phase abbreviations ά (tempered martensite), γ (austenite), δ (delta ferrite), RD (rolling direction) and ND (normal direction).

The citing text reports that needle-shaped reverted austenite in IA750_5 Min measures 2.829±0.30 µm along the major axis and 0.350±0.20 µm along the minor axis, and 1.42±0.16 µm / 0.345±0.40 µm in IA750_60 Min; these dimensions are not printed on the figure itself.
The citing text states that EDS of the needle-shaped reverted austenite and α-ferrite region at 5 min gives Mn 8.30±0.20 wt.% and Al 4.43±0.05 wt.%, matching the values printed in table A3.
The citing text asserts that SEM characterisation of IA750_60 Min showed no carbide formation at the micron scale, an absence that must be judged from the micrographs alone.
Across rows, the fraction of needle/globular reverted austenite visible in the high-magnification SEM decreases from A2 to E2, consistent with its progressive dissolution into intercritical ferrite.

subfigures.description: Low-magnification SEM of IA750_5 Min with coarse island-like phase labelled δ and fine lath constituent labelled α/γ; scale bar ~10 µm; an annotation arrow marks untransformed austenite (white arrow per the citing text).

Higher-magnification SEM of IA750_5 Min (2 µm scale bar) showing sharp needle-shaped reverted austenite inside a martensite/ferrite matrix; a red arrow marks needle-shaped reverted austenite and a yellow plus sign marks an α-ferrite spot.

EDS spectrum of IA750_5 Min with labelled C, Al, Si, Mn and Fe peaks plus inset table: δ-ferrite Al 5.37±0.05, Mn 7.09±0.09 wt.%; untransformed austenite Al 4.50±0.14, Mn 8.07±0.11 wt.%; reverted austenite Al 4.43±0.05, Mn 8.30±0.20 wt.%.
Low-magnification SEM of IA750_30 Min, ~10 µm scale bar, with δ and α/γ phase labels.
Higher-magnification SEM of IA750_30 Min (2 µm scale bar) showing a band of needle-like constituent with yellow and blue marker annotations.
EDS spectrum plus table for IA750_30 Min: δ-ferrite Al 5.76±0.01, Mn 6.95±0.03; reverted austenite Al 4.77±0.18, Mn 8.21±0.24; intercritical ferrite Al 5.71±0.05, Mn 6.26±0.15 wt.%.
Low-magnification SEM of IA750_60 Min (~20 µm scale bar) with δ and α/γ phase labels; δ-ferrite islands are rounded.

Higher-magnification SEM of IA750_60 Min (2 µm scale bar) with needle-shaped reverted austenite and a red outlined circle marking globular reverted austenite; yellow plus, red star and coloured dots mark EDS locations.

EDS spectrum plus table for IA750_60 Min: δ-ferrite Al 5.25±0.13, Mn 7.44±0.40; intercritical ferrite Al 5.08±0.22, Mn 6.50±0.17; untransformed austenite Al 4.04±0.13, Mn 9.83±0.37; reverted austenite Al 3.96±0.15, Mn 7.58±0.14 wt.%.
Low-magnification SEM of IA750_120 Min, ~10 µm scale bar, δ and α/γ labelled.
Higher-magnification SEM of IA750_120 Min (5 µm scale bar) showing fewer and finer needle/globular features with red and blue dot markers.
EDS spectrum plus table for IA750_120 Min: δ-ferrite Al 5.63±0.10, Mn 6.65±0.23; untransformed austenite Al 4.64±0.10, Mn 9.15±0.05; intercritical ferrite Al 5.0±0.36, Mn 6.54±0.08 wt.%.
Low-magnification SEM of IA750_180 Min, ~20 µm scale bar, δ and α/γ labelled.
Higher-magnification SEM of IA750_180 Min (5 µm scale bar) showing a matrix that is mostly intercritical ferrite with few residual fine features; red and blue dot markers.
EDS spectrum plus table for IA750_180 Min: δ-ferrite Al 5.85±0.03, Mn 6.62±0.22; untransformed austenite Al 4.66±0.06, Mn 9.42±0.10; intercritical ferrite Al 5.27±0.10, Mn 7.95±0.25 wt.%.
